title: Good, interesting stuff
text:
We look forward to our snack box each month. Sure, there are a few duplicates here and there, but there are only so many snacks like this in the world! It's a fun way to try new things before paying full price for a full pack of something. It also gets things in front of you that you may have not known existed.
I think we're on month 4 or so now. No plans on canceling any time soon.
label: positive
